claims: Common is from South Side Chicago, IL.
Common's real name is Lonnie Rashid Lynn, Jr.
Lonnie Corant Jaman Shuka Rashid Lynn is Common's name.
Common debuted as "Common Sense" with the 1994 album Resurrection.
Common shortened his stage name from "Common Sense" to "Common" after a lawsuit threat.
Common's musical styles are conscious rap, jazz-rap, and alternative hip-hop.
Common had a past relationship with Erykah Badu.
Common collaborated with Erykah Badu on the Grammy-winning "Love of My Life".
Common founded the Common Ground Foundation.
The Common Ground Foundation focuses on youth education and empowerment.
Common won an Oscar in 2015 for "Glory".
